modules.name: Swerve
modules.description: Bounce generator: a triangle that rises and falls between two CV bounds at separate up and down slopes; narrow the bounds and it speeds up, cross them and it goes into paradox. LFO to audio, one-shot mode, top/bottom pulses

modules.name: Gallop
modules.description: Four bounce oscillators stacked so each is bounded by its neighbours: they push each other into shifting, chaotic shapes. Tilt, CV, bound inserts, paradox, mix and poly outs, scope

modules.name: Tumble
modules.description: Five coupled rhythm cores with touch knobs between neighbours that pull them together or push them apart; each strikes its own gong. Gates out, stereo gongs, sync
